candidates.title: The Architect's wager
candidates.description: The Silent faces a Corrupted Defect above their native card hands while the Architect looms over the workshop. Body-only CPU emulation of the native spectral shader at t=60.8 s and strength 0.75 adds cyan/violet echoes, a narrow sliding band, icy scanlines, and mild desaturation; approved armillary remains at t=2.4 s and opacity 1.

candidates.title: Face your echo
candidates.description: Two Ironclads face each other across a brass mechanism, with the corrupted counterpart bound in the approved armillary. Body-only CPU emulation of the native spectral shader at t=60.8 s and strength 0.75 adds cyan/violet echoes, a narrow sliding band, icy scanlines, and mild desaturation; approved armillary remains at t=2.4 s and opacity 1.

candidates.title: The gilded prisoner
candidates.description: A Corrupted Regent stands inside a brass workshop alcove beside the Architect and an oversized, left-aligned title. Body-only CPU emulation of the native spectral shader at t=60.8 s and strength 0.75 adds cyan/violet echoes, a narrow sliding band, icy scanlines, and mild desaturation; approved armillary remains at t=2.4 s and opacity 1.
